messages.subject: How do you get a local version of Leaflet? / How do you run the jcheng interactive map Shiny Demo?
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to run one of the Shiny Showcase examples on my computer:

https://github.com/jcheng5/leaflet-shiny

I've downloaded the project from github and unpacked it, but I can't see how to run it, or how to get hold of Leaflet?

I don't want to have to obtain all the source code for Leaflet on my machine.

I noticed that jcheng's github project has an issue logged, to do with running the project locally, and the latest comment on it is:

"If you happen to be interested in a self-contained leaflet-shiny, here it is.

Serve leaflet js and css locally; provide leaflet 0.6.4."


I don't understand what this comment means. Is there a file somewhere I need to download to get a copy of Leaflet? Or is this comment providing example code that I need to run somewhere?


Any guidance would be greatly appreciated, thanks!

messages.author: ac45f3e5ae13f115
messages.subject: Re: How do you get a local version of Leaflet? / How do you run the jcheng interactive map Shiny Demo?
parts:
This thread explains how to install the package and run the demo

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/V7WUQA7aAiI/pPDbdIxEWHkJ

As for the comment, it means you can switch to a self contained project (no Internet connection necessary) by changing the path to a local copy of the leaflet library. To make it work, you have to modify the leaflet.R and install the package again. If you plan to distribute the code of your Shiny App you will also have to provide the modified leaflet package. The required changes can be found on GitHub :

https://github.com/jcheng5/leaflet-shiny/pull/1/files
